name: has-unit-per-file-read-transaction
body: The full-load fallback's reuse-candidate admission probes FactStore::has_unit once per unchanged file, opening one read transaction per file on every incremental scan. The per-file probe is correct but linear in read-transaction overhead; if a large-tree rescan's time budget regresses, add a single-read-transaction batched probe to cache::FactStore and use it here.
